description: Patch a scheduled task's name, prompt, schedule, skip-guard, or enabled state — only the fields passed are changed. To change the schedule, set interval/time/timezone together (plus weekday or dayOfMonth as the interval requires). This tool calls the SHIP API, documented at https://letsship.ai/docs/api. Requires the config:write capability.

dayOfMonth.description: Day of month, 1-28 — required when interval is 'monthly' (capped at 28 so every month has the day).

enabled.description: Set false to pause the schedule without deleting the scheduled task

interval.description: Fire cadence. 'weekly' requires weekday; 'monthly' requires dayOfMonth.

labels.description: Tracker label names put on every issue this scheduled task files (replaces the list; [] clears it). The label must ALREADY exist in the project's tracker team — the platform attaches labels but cannot create them, so a name the workspace does not have is dropped.

name.description: Scheduled task name, shown in the console and used in the issue title

skipIfPreviousOpen.description: Skip a scheduled fire while the previous fire's mission is still open (default true — the guardrail is opt-out, not opt-in)

weekday.description: Day of week — required when interval is 'weekly'.

name: update_scheduled_task
title: Update a scheduled task
